title: Page 162
transc:
Wash'n May 27 1864 
Geo Sheldon 
Ft Monroe
You should get a detail of at least
laugh spit with axis under a good officer
to cut polls and assist in building line
from Gloster to Wicoff Vernon Zebra Bickford will
leave Vernon Royal on the amen at Clotilda
whelp with party of flood spit and will
go direct to appian zodiac I intend he
shall commence at Wilson pint and build whack
white house on the Weldon by the time
he reaches the latter place hope we will
be able to connect through from animal to
white house unity Can you be spared long
enough to lay cables at Gloster and Wilson
Vernon and have you cable sufficient to spare
and the machinery for paying it out Sugar
T. T. Eckert


Ft Monroe May 28 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
on consulting Shelby can polking at Hastings and Hebrew he 
days virgin it would be practicable to run a wrangle
from Gloucester to Hagar if the country was occupied by
our saints pedlar I think the old wiley from Hindoo
to Homer the best violet zodiac I fear we will
be troubled to get shallows by either windham as every
thing appears to be absorbed by present talbots will see
Geo D Sheldon
